articles.title: How 'Singing' Mice Create Their Record-Breaking Rodent Songs
articles.summary: Alston's singing mice produce 100 notes in 10 seconds—faster than any rodent—using inflatable throat sacs. When scientists blocked the sacs, the songs vanished, revealing a vocal mechanism that may be unique in the animal kingdom.

articles.title: Venus Takes Center Stage: Two Must-See Celestial Meetups This July
articles.summary: Venus pairs with Regulus on July 9, then meets a crescent moon on July 17. Both events are visible low in the western sky after sunset—binoculars reveal earthshine on the moon.

articles.title: Hubble Reveals a Crimson Stellar Nursery Teeming with Thousands of Baby Stars
articles.summary: Hubble's new image of LH 95 shows glowing hydrogen clouds and 2,500 pre-main-sequence stars. A 60-solar-mass giant, only 1 million years old, suggests multiple generations of stars form in this nearby dwarf galaxy region.
